reports.title: WMO Recommended Practices and Standards for Meteorological Observation
reports.description: WMO technical regulations and recommended practices governing quality control, processing, archiving, and instrumentation/observation methods for meteorological and climatological data, followed by national meteorological services worldwide.

reports.title: Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS)
reports.description: Household-level socioeconomic census mandated by Republic Act 11315 (CBMS Act), administered by PSA in coordination with LGUs, providing granular data used to identify poor and near-poor households for targeting of social programs.

reports.title: Census of Agriculture and Fisheries
reports.description: PSA's periodic census of agricultural and fishing operations/households, used as the sampling frame for PSA's commodity-specific production surveys.

reports.title: General Appropriations Act
reports.publisher: Congress of the Philippines / Department of Budget and Management
reports.description: The annual national budget law that authorizes and itemizes appropriations for all Philippine government agencies, including defense.

reports.title: Republic Act No. 9513 — Renewable Energy Act of 2008
reports.publisher: Congress of the Philippines / Department of Energy
reports.description: Statute that defines renewable energy resources (including geothermal, hydro, wind, solar, biomass and ocean) and is the legal framework cited in DOE energy-mix and RE statistics.

reports.title: Palay Production Survey
reports.description: PSA quarterly/annual survey of palay area, production and yield; the direct source named in PSA commodity fact sheets for rice statistics.

reports.title: NDRRMC situational reports on disaster casualties and damage
reports.publisher: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
reports.description: Official government tallies of persons affected, casualties and peso damage to agriculture, infrastructure and houses, used by PAGASA and PSA environment statistics as the impact source.

reports.title: Overseas Filipino Cash Remittances by Country (BSP Table 11)
reports.description: BSP country-by-source cash remittance series compiled from banks and remittance companies; parent table from which the Canada slice is taken.

dependencies.basis: PSA's technical notes for the Compendium of Philippine Environment Statistics state the compendium (housing forest-cover/forest-fire tables sourced from the Forest Management Bureau) is an adoption of the FDES 2013 framework.
dependencies.evidence_quote: It is an adoption of the Framework for the Development of Environment Statistics (FDES) 2013.

dependencies.basis: PAGASA's own 'About Us' page states its quality control, processing, archiving of meteorological/climatological data and observation procedures are done per WMO recommended practices and standards.

DBM's official NTA guidance for FY2024 states LGU shares are computed from certified collection totals of the national tax-collecting agencies (BIR, BOC, BTr) — the same national government revenue data tracked under NG fiscal operations statistics.
The PDP 2023-2028's headline-indicators results matrix names PSA's National Accounts of the Philippines as official means of verification for its GDP growth targets.
The same results matrix cites the PSA Labor Force Survey as verification source for employment/unemployment targets.
The plan's poverty-reduction targets are verified against PSA's Family Income and Expenditure Survey per its results matrix.
PSA's PDESA technical notes list the National Accounts of the Philippines as a direct input to the digital-economy value-added estimates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Gross Output of Information and publishing, Manufacturing of computer, electronic and optical products, Wholesale trade, Communications, Professional and business services, and Other services of NAP are used as data inputs in the estimation process.

dependencies.basis: The same PDESA technical notes list ASPBI as a direct data input to the digital-economy estimation methodology.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Annual Survey of Philippine Business and Industry (ASPBI) and Census of Philippine Business and Industry (CPBI) Provides information on the Gross Output of selected industries, sales from e-commerce transactions, and employment in digital economy industries.

dependencies.basis: PSA's 2025 digital-economy press release reports e-commerce's GVA/employment shares as a component decomposition mechanically produced within the PDESA breakdown.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The digital economy covers four major components of goods and services: Digital-enabling infrastructure, Digital content and media, E-commerce, and Government digital services.

dependencies.basis: PSA's 2022 ASPBI IT-BPM industries report states the survey's economic-unit classification is based on the 2009 PSIC as formally adopted by PSA Board resolution.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The 2022 ASPBI covered establishments engaged in 18 sections classified according to the 2009 Philippine Standard Industrial Classification (PSIC)

dependencies.basis: DSWD's own Pantawid Pamilya site states 4Ps formally adopted PSA's CBMS as its Standardized Targeting System, registering new beneficiaries directly from the CBMS poor/near-poor database.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), through the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), will begin registering more than 493,000 new beneficiaries starting in March using data from the Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS) as the official basis for identifying eligible families.

dependencies.basis: PhilHealth's own Stats and Charts 2025 report cites PSA's Scenario 2 population projection as the population figure used in its statistical presentation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: *** 2025 Estimated Projected Population is 113,863,084 (Philippine Statistics Authority’s Scenario 2)

dependencies.basis: PSA's gender-statistics page states the Women and Men in the Philippines / Core GAD Indicators factsheet is compiled from named surveys including the Labor Force Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: includes data from the latest surveys, statistical reports and publications such as the 2025 Labor Force Survey, 2024 Survey on Overseas Filipinos, 2023 Family Income and Expenditure Survey, 2025 National Demographic and Health Survey

dependencies.basis: The same PSA gender-statistics page names FIES as a feeder survey for the Core GAD Indicators factsheet.
dependencies.evidence_quote: includes data from the latest surveys, statistical reports and publications such as the 2025 Labor Force Survey, 2024 Survey on Overseas Filipinos, 2023 Family Income and Expenditure Survey, 2025 National Demographic and Health Survey

dependencies.basis: PSA's Technical Notes on Household Characteristics confirm housing/household statistics are drawn directly from the 2020 Census of Population and Housing sample.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) conducted the 2020 Census of Population and Housing (2020 CPH) in September 2020, with 01 May 2020 as the reference date.

dependencies.basis: BSP's Depository Corporations Survey primer states monetary statistics compilation is consistent with the 2008 SNA framework.
The same BSP primer states the monetary aggregates framework is aligned with BPM6, alongside the IMF's Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual.
dependencies.evidence_quote: In the CBS, Accounts are classified according to financial instruments, transactors or institutional units and residence. The foreign and domestic positions are distinguished on the basis of residence following the guidelines of the IMF’s BPM6.

dependencies.basis: BSP's own inflation-targeting page states the government's inflation target is defined directly in terms of the PSA-compiled CPI.

The Bureau of the Treasury's fiscal risk/debt statement discloses that external-debt-related figures within its debt statistics are compiled on a Balance of Payments Manual concept, shifting from BPM5 to BPM6.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources: NEDA, NSO, NSCB, BSP, and BTr a/ Macroeconomic assumptions adopted by the Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC), as published in the annual Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing (BESF) that the Executive branch submitted to Congress for the preparation of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) b/ Based on primary market rates c/ Based on the Balance of Payments Manual 5 (BPM5) concept, except for 2013 actual and 2014 assumptions, which are based on the Balance of Payments Manual 6 (BPM6) concept

dependencies.basis: PSA's own LFS Technical Notes define underemployment as an indicator computed directly from LFS respondent data, not a separately collected dataset.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Specifically, the survey is designed to provide statistics on the levels and trends of employment, unemployment, and underemployment for the country and for each of the regions.

dependencies.basis: PSA's Technical Notes on the 2022 Survey on Overseas Filipinos state SOF is conducted as a rider survey to the October LFS round, using the LFS's Master Sample design.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The SOF is conducted every year as a rider survey to the October round of the Labor Force Survey (LFS).

dependencies.basis: PSA-BARMM's Provincial Product Accounts page states its estimates are compiled consistent with the National and Regional Accounts of the Philippines.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Provincial Product Accounts or PPA has been the mechanism of the PSA to compile the annual estimates of Gross Domestic Product by province and Highly Urbanized City (HUC), consistent with the National and Regional Accounts of the Philippines.

dependencies.basis: PSA's technical notes for the Highlights of Philippine Export and Import Statistics state all traded commodities, nickel included, are classified using the 2022 PSCC.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The 2022 Philippine Standard Commodity Classification (PSCC) is used to classify the commodities at the 11-digit code level for statistical purposes.

dependencies.basis: The same PSA technical notes describe the IMTS compilation process (BOC-declaration-based) that produces all Philippine export/import and trade-partner figures, nickel included.
PSA's Technical Notes on the Palay and Corn Production Survey state the survey's primary sampling units are drawn from the 2012 Census of Agriculture and Fisheries.
DND's own Transparency page states its published approved budget figures are line items set by the General Appropriations Act (RA 11518, GAA FY2021), with DBM tracking compliance.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The General Appropriations Act (GAA) for Fiscal Year 2021, released by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) on 28 December 2020, states in Section 96 the requirements for the Transparency Seal Compliance: … (ii) approved budgets and corresponding targets, immediately upon approval of this Act

dependencies.basis: National energy mix is calculated from DOE monthly grid generation-by-technology reports.
Geothermal generation statistics use DOE's gross generation by region/technology series.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Source: 2023 DOE Power Statistics Note: -includes Grid-connected (Grid and Embedded/Self-Gen Facilities) & Offgrid (Private or NPC SPUG-owned) -Regional Generation depends on the location of the Generating facilities

dependencies.basis: RE statistics reporting is legally grounded in the Renewable Energy Act of 2008 (RA 9513).
Rice commodity fact sheet sources area/production/yield figures from PSA's Palay Production Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: volume of fisheries production by species are sourced from the crops, livestock and poultry, and fishery surveys of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), as follows: a. Palay Production Survey

dependencies.basis: Rice's share in agricultural value of production is calculated from the national agriculture accounts.
Fisheries production volumes use PSA's quarterly fisheries surveys, feeding the national agriculture/fisheries accounts.
Manila/N. Luzon PMO port statistics are a regional cut calculated from the national PPA port statistics summary.
Canada-specific OFW remittance figures are calculated from BSP's country breakdown of cash remittances.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Table 11 Overseas Filipino Cash Remittances by country, by source 1 in thousand US dollars; for periods indicated

dependencies.basis: Country-level remittance data uses BSP's balance-of-payments remittance compilation.
Digital economy measurement in the PSNA depends on the PSIC industry classification, expanded to cover digital/household unincorporated activities.
Outstanding national government debt figures are sourced from the Bureau of the Treasury's cash operations / debt reporting.
BARMM regional statistics use the 2024 Census of Population figures.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The total population of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) as of 01 July 2024 is 5,691,583 based on the 2024 Census of Population (2024 POPCEN).

dependencies.basis: Nationally Determined Contribution reporting uses the national GHG Inventory for its mitigation-claim verification.
Monetary aggregates (M3/domestic liquidity) are compiled by BSP's Department of Economic Statistics.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Department of Economic Statistics (DES) of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) compiles monetary statistics in accordance with framework as set forth in the Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide (MFSMCG) of the International Monetary Fund (IMF). The monetary statistics is comprised of the Central Bank Survey (CBS), the Depository Corporations Survey (DCS), and the Other Financial Corporations Survey (OFCS).

dependencies.basis: Construction sector classification in the PSNA depends on the PSIC's 16 major industry groupings.

SETTLED as a negative, and the premise recorded here was wrong in two ways. The '2025 SNA' phrase comes from a PSA-authored deck reachable at https://www.unsiap.or.jp/sites/default/files/doc/2026-04/11_Philippine's%20Experience.pdf (psa.gov.ph itself is Cloudflare-walled on every host and path). Adoption of the 2025 System of National Accounts recommendations, particularly in covering activities i.e., content creation and trade on digital platforms (free and fee-based) including the non-traditional work arrangements." That is an aspiration, not a documented dependency, so it supports no edge to sna-2008 OR to a 2025-SNA node. Second correction: sna-2025 ALREADY EXISTS in international-standards.json, so the modelling question was never whether the corpus needs one.
